method: Synthetic nonzero-radius sphere probes aimed at up to three selected faces per installed MODC polyhedron, each point center and each edge midpoint. Authored face/edge IDs, normals, extra vertices and primitive shape tables are parsed from all installed GFXM resources. Fixed eight-unit radius, forty-unit start offset, eighty-unit closing velocity and declared fractional Q16 object translation. One in four queries plus all point/edge queries receive complete retained-instruction shape-query comparisons. Complete port outputs and input probes are retained below. No original process execution or gameplay observation.
